text_block_list.name: Club Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Assistant Coach!
The Japan Cup is starting soon, isn't it?!
Let's go watch it on TV!

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Right, the timing seems about right.
Let's all head to the meeting room.

text_block_list.name: Club Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I'm so excited for Bubble-san and the others' race! After all, they're the sub-coach's rivals!

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
...My irreplaceable, dearest friend."

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: ...Do your best. Bubble. Cure.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to this year's Japan Cup, it's all about Bubble vs. Air Groove!
I'm so hyped for it~!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Based on how the Tenno Sho (Autumn) went, Air Groove definitely has a shot at winning too!
It's gonna be an incredible race...!

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, in the end,
all I did this autumn was watch from the sidelines~.

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm the only one who can see this through to the end! Cure-chan, Bubble-chan, you got this~!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —I feel kind of strange.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
A whole year has already passed, huh?
Since that Japan Cup.
choice_data_list: ...You've gotten so much stronger than you were back then.
...You've gotten so much stronger since back then.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
It's all thanks to everyone, and to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...In today's Japan Cup,
I'll beat my rivals and prove it.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Witness my strength.
Witness my potential...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That Bubble Gum Fellow is an Umamusume
whose strength knows no limits!
choice_data_list: Let's make our dreams grow big!
Let's make our dreams grow big!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Leave it to me!!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text: ――Hey, Bubble.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Cure! Nice to meet you today.

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text: Yeah, nice to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
......You know, Bubble.
I'm secretly quite proud of it.

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text: That out of the "Big Four," I was the one who watched Bubble's hoofprints the most, and from the closest vantage point.

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
"...Let's show them together today.
The running of us 'Four Heavenly Kings,' to the whole world."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—
You're right. Let's make it flashy...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...At this point, there's no need to restate it, is there?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed.
We have both made our declarations."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Well then—
shall we begin?
